title: Players
description: Engagement and retention for one game.

list.label: Game
list.query:
WITH seen AS (SELECT game_id FROM meridian.events WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY game_id)
SELECT game_id, if(g.name = '', toString(game_id), g.name) AS label
FROM seen LEFT JOIN (SELECT game_id, name FROM meridian.games FINAL) AS g USING (game_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 0, 'No data yet' WHERE (SELECT count() FROM seen) = 0

panels.title: Players

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS players, countIf(first_join >= $__fromTime) AS new, countIf(first_join < $__fromTime) AS returning
FROM (
    SELECT user_id, min(ts) AS first_join, max(ts) AS last_join
    FROM meridian.events
    WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND ts <= $__toTime
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING last_join >= $__fromTime
)

panels.description: Players who joined in the selected time range. New players joined for the first time in it. First visits are only known for the last 90 days of data.

panels.title: Active players

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    uniqExactIf(user_id, ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS DAU,
    uniqExactIf(user_id, ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS WAU,
    uniqExact(user_id) AS MAU
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.description: Players who joined in the last 1, 7, and 30 days, regardless of the time picker.

panels.title: Stickiness

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * uniqExactIf(user_id, ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) / nullIf(uniqExact(user_id), 0) AS stickiness
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.description: Daily active players as a share of monthly active players (DAU / MAU).

panels.title: Sessions per player

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() / nullIf(uniqExact(user_id), 0) AS sessions
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Average joins per player in the selected time range.

panels.title: Median session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration')) AS median
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'leave' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Median length of sessions that ended in the selected time range.

panels.title: Playtime per player

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration')) / nullIf(uniqExact(user_id), 0) AS playtime
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'leave' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Average total playtime per player across sessions that ended in the selected time range.

panels.title: Peak online

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(players) AS peak
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS minute, uniqExact(session_id) AS players
    FROM meridian.events
    WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'position' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY minute
)

panels.description: Most players online in any one minute, from position samples.

panels.title: Retention

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    cohorts AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(min(ts)) AS cohort FROM meridian.events WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' GROUP BY user_id),
    days AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, toDate(ts) AS day FROM meridian.events WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join')
SELECT
    100 * countIf(d1 AND cohort + 1 < today()) / nullIf(countIf(cohort + 1 < today()), 0) AS `Day 1`,
    100 * countIf(d7 AND cohort + 7 < today()) / nullIf(countIf(cohort + 7 < today()), 0) AS `Day 7`,
    100 * countIf(d30 AND cohort + 30 < today()) / nullIf(countIf(cohort + 30 < today()), 0) AS `Day 30`
FROM (
    SELECT c.user_id, c.cohort,
        max(d.day = c.cohort + 1) AS d1, max(d.day = c.cohort + 7) AS d7, max(d.day = c.cohort + 30) AS d30
    FROM cohorts AS c INNER JOIN days AS d ON d.user_id = c.user_id
    GROUP BY c.user_id, c.cohort
)

panels.description: Share of new players who came back exactly 1, 7, or 30 days after their first visit (UTC days), over every player first seen in the last 90 days whose day N has passed. Ignores the time picker.

panels.title: Daily players: new vs returning

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohorts AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(min(ts)) AS cohort FROM meridian.events WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' GROUP BY user_id)
SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, uniqExactIf(user_id, day = cohort) AS new, uniqExactIf(user_id, day > cohort) AS returning
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, toDate(ts) AS day
    FROM meridian.events
    WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
) AS a
INNER JOIN cohorts USING (user_id)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

panels.description: Players who joined each UTC day, split by whether it was their first day.

panels.title: Concurrent players

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(minute) AS time, max(players) AS peak
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS minute, uniqExact(session_id) AS players
    FROM meridian.events
    WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'position' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY minute
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Peak players online in each interval, from per-minute position samples.

panels.title: Session length

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
    quantileExact(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration')) AS median,
    quantileExact(0.9)(JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration')) AS p90
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'leave' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Median and 90th percentile length of sessions ending in each interval.

panels.title: Sessions per player

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(n = 1, '1', n = 2, '2', n <= 5, '3-5', n <= 10, '6-10', n <= 20, '11-20', '21+') AS sessions,
    count() AS players
FROM (
    SELECT user_id, count() AS n
    FROM meridian.events
    WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY user_id
)
GROUP BY sessions
ORDER BY min(n)

panels.description: How many times each player joined in the selected time range.

panels.title: Retention by cohort

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    cohorts AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(min(ts)) AS cohort FROM meridian.events WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join' GROUP BY user_id),
    days AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, toDate(ts) AS day FROM meridian.events WHERE game_id = $game AND event = 'join')
SELECT
    toString(cohort) AS `first day`,
    count() AS players,
    if(cohort + 1 < today(), round(100 * countIf(d1) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `Day 1`,
    if(cohort + 3 < today(), round(100 * countIf(d3) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `Day 3`,
    if(cohort + 7 < today(), round(100 * countIf(d7) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `Day 7`,
    if(cohort + 14 < today(), round(100 * countIf(d14) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `Day 14`,
    if(cohort + 30 < today(), round(100 * countIf(d30) / count(), 1), NULL) AS `Day 30`
FROM (
    SELECT c.user_id, c.cohort, max(d.day = c.cohort + 1) AS d1, max(d.day = c.cohort + 3) AS d3, max(d.day = c.cohort + 7) AS d7, max(d.day = c.cohort + 14) AS d14, max(d.day = c.cohort + 30) AS d30
    FROM cohorts AS c INNER JOIN days AS d ON d.user_id = c.user_id
    WHERE c.cohort >= toDate($__fromTime) AND c.cohort <= toDate($__toTime)
    GROUP BY c.user_id, c.cohort
)
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort DESC

panels.description: Players grouped by their first UTC day, and the share who came back exactly N days later. Empty cells haven't happened yet.

panels.title: Top players

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toString(user_id) AS player,
    countIf(event = 'join') AS sessions,
    sumIf(JSONExtractFloat(props, 'duration'), event = 'leave') AS playtime,
    countIf(event = 'death') AS deaths,
    countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchases,
    min(ts) AS first_event,
    max(ts) AS last_event
FROM meridian.events
WHERE game_id = $game AND user_id != 0 AND event IN ('join', 'leave', 'death', 'purchase') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY playtime DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.description: Players with the most playtime in the selected time range. Click a player to open their Roblox profile.
